notes: Orange Tree (orangetree.in) is a Shopify store, fully reachable via direct HTTP (200s, no block); robots.txt has no Claude disallow (explicitly allows anthropic-ai/Claude-Web). Discovery: enumerated the FULL collections.json catalog (300 collections, 2 pages at limit=250) and scanned every title/handle/body_html for clearance-style terms (clearance, outlet, final sale, last chance, end of line, discontinued, liquidat*, markdown, stock clear*) -- zero matches anywhere in the 300-collection catalog. Also checked main nav (top-level items: Gifting/Bestsellers/Blogs/Trade Program/Design Projects/Our Stores/Franchise Enquiry -- no Sale/Clearance/Outlet item), the full 'SHOP BY CATEGORY' mega-menu accordion tree (Furniture/Living/Bedroom/Dining/Outdoor/Study/Lighting/Hanging Lamps/Decor/Table Styling/Serveware/Wall Decor/OT x Muse Mart/New Collections -- no sale/clearance entry), footer link list, and sitemap_collections_1.xml. Inspected the closest candidates individually and ruled each out: 'Father's day sale' / 'Mother's day sale' / 'Diwali Furniture Offer' are festival-named temporary promotional campaigns (excluded per the Sale-vs-Clearance test -- no permanence/outlet framing, purely seasonal); 'Product not on Sale' (handle product-not-on-sale, 1410 cached) is literally the inverse listing (items NOT discounted), not a clearance page; 'sale out of stock' (handle sale-out-of-stock) is a technical/utility collection that is EXACTLY ZERO products on exhaustive products.json pagination despite a cached products_count=168 -- dropped as empty regardless; 'OT Offerings' (handle above50-ot-offerings, 24 exact unique products) was opened and checked product-level pricing -- all sampled variants have compare_at_price=null (no markdown at all) and normal-looking prices, with no clearance/outlet copy on the page -- no clearance signal found. No page anywhere on the site uses Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale/Last Chance/End of Line language for a real product listing. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance PLP exists on this site, and nothing found was ambiguous enough to warrant a flagged row (the near-misses above were conclusively ruled out on inspection, not merely uncertain).
